# FOOT ULCER IN PATIENT WITH DIABETES MELLITUS

Foot ulcers in patients with diabetes mellitus are colonized with bacteria. Do

not treat colonization with systemic antimicrobials.

[Foot ulcers WITH infection of surrounding tissues](orzid2-gmenu-foot-ulcer-w-infect-surr-tissues)
